q: Stein's equation A*PA − P = −Q for discrete-time systems (where A is stable: all eigenvalues inside unit disk) has a unique positive definite solution P when Q > 0. This P is the infinite-horizon LQR cost:
opts: The discrete-time observability Gramian W_o = Σ_{k=0}^∞ (A*)^k Q A^k
exp: Discrete Stein equation A*PA − P = −Q has unique solution P = Σ_{k=0}^∞ (A*)^k Q A^k (discrete observability Gramian). For A stable, the series converges. P is the cost matrix for the discrete LQR problem with stage cost x*Qx. The dual equation APA* − P = −Q gives the reachability Gramian.
